name: LethAL Sandbox MultiObject
brief: LethAL R383 fixture: two codeunits in one file, and a single-object control.
description: MultiPair.Codeunit.al holds Multi A then Multi B; B's Reached ends on the line right before Unreached starts, so a base line one off moves a covered statement into the wrong procedure. MultiControl.Codeunit.al is a single-object control. Run by itest:alrunner. Deliberately its OWN app and id range so no other frozen baseline moves. Not for production use, see fixtures/README.md.
